name: reveal
description: Make a hidden entity known when the player notices, finds, or reaches it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the hidden entity.

name: move
description: Move an actor to a new location, or move a nearby item.

entity_id.description: Exact actor or item id. The item must be carried by the player or loose here.

to_id.description:
Exact destination id. Use a location for an actor; for an item, use `player`,
an actor here, or the player's location.

name: gain_improvised_item
description: Give the player an ordinary, unimportant object not already in the world.

item_name.description: The object's name, such as `a handful of gravel`.

name: add_trait
description: Add a lasting condition or quality to an entity.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Stable slug, such as `poisoned`. `battle-worn` displays as Battle Worn.

text.description: The trait's effect in plain language.

name: remove_trait
description: Remove a lasting condition or quality that has ended.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Exact id of one of the entity's traits.

name: advance_thread
description: Update an active storyline's status, stage, clock, or note.

thread_id.description: Exact id of an ACTIVE THREAD.

status.description: New status, or null to keep the current status.

stage.description: New stage slug, or null to keep the current stage.

tick.description: Number of segments to fill on its clock. Use 0 for no change.

note.description: New private note for the Director, or null to keep the current note.

name: unlock_exit
description: Unlock an exit from the player's location.

to_id.description: Exact id of the exit's destination.

name: join_party
description: Add an actor here to the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor joining.

name: leave_party
description: Remove an actor from the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor leaving.

name: roll_attempt
description:
Roll one risky attempt. Roll an NPC's attempt directly; put the player's own attempt
to `stake_attempt` first, unless their words already accepted the exact risk.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who takes the action.

goal.description: The actor's goal, in one line.

skill.description: Matching skill from the actor's sheet, or empty for d6.

helped.description: Helpful circumstance that adds d6. Empty when using `helper_id` or no help.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who adds their skill die, or null for no helper.

helper_skill.description: Matching skill from the helper's sheet, or empty for their d6.

hindered.description: Hindering circumstance that lowers the actor's die to d4, or empty.

luck_test.description: Separate bad luck that may arrive, or empty for no test.

name: stake_attempt
description: Let the player accept or revise one risky attempt before rolling it.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who takes the action.

goal.description: The actor's goal, in one line.

skill.description: Matching skill from the actor's sheet, or empty for d6.

helped.description: Helpful circumstance that adds d6. Empty when using `helper_id` or no help.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who adds their skill die, or null for no helper.

helper_skill.description: Matching skill from the helper's sheet, or empty for their d6.

hindered.description: Hindering circumstance that lowers the actor's die to d4, or empty.

luck_test.description: Separate bad luck that may arrive, or empty for no test.

risk.description: One-line cost of a bad roll, shown to the player.

name: settle_defence
description: Apply the player's choice to break an item or take the full hit.

item_id.description: Exact id of the carried, unbroken item to break, or null to take the hit.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here facing bad luck.

subject.description: Possible bad luck, such as low ammo or nearby guards.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or an actor here.

amount.description: Positive pays the actor; negative charges them.

name: complete_chapter
description: Record that the current job has ended.
